quick_start.recommended_input: Seat one adult night botanist beside a misted greenhouse pane with amber service lights outside. Let the fingertip draw one continuous leaf outline by displacing condensation, with no magical glow. Have her look from the finished leaf toward camera and hold one quiet relieved breath.
